52202.meaning1: two Pātimokkhas; precepts for Buddhist monks and nuns

52203.meaning1: expert in the Abhidhamma; (comm) who knows the two Pātimokkha; who knows the summaries of the Dhamma and Vinaya

examples.text: idha pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃ vadeyya, asukasmiṃ nāma āvāse sambahulā therā bhikkhū viharanti bahussutā āgat'āgamā dhammadharā vinayadharā mātikādharā. tesaṃ me therānaṃ sammukhā sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ

52205.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of māti
52205.commentary: (ANa) mātito ca pitito cā'ti yassa mātā brāhmaṇī, mātu mātā brāhmaṇī, tassā'pi mātā brāhmaṇī. pitā brāhmaṇo, pitu pitā brāhmaṇo, tassā'pi pitā brāhmaṇo, so ubhato sujāto mātito ca pitito ca.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, rañño bhaddo ass'ājānīyo ubhato sujāto hoti, mātito ca pitito ca. yassaṃ disāyaṃ aññe'pi bhaddā ass'ājānīyā jāyanti, tassaṃ disāyaṃ jāto hoti.
aññātikā nāma mātito vā pitito vā yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā asambaddhā.

52206.meaning1: mother's side of the family; maternal lineage
52206.commentary: (PYt) mātipakkha-pitipakkhato'ti mātuyā pakkho mātipakkho, pituno pakkho pitipakkho, mātipakkho ca pitipakkho ca mātipakkhapitipakkhā.

examples.text: mahantaṃ ñātisaṃghaṃ ohāyāt'i mātipakkhe asītikulasahassāni, pitipakkhe asītikulasahassānī'ti evaṃ saṭṭhikulasatasahassaṃ ohāya pabbajito.
tapojigucchāya āyuttā, pālayaṃ pavivekiyaṃ, rūpe ca ye niviṭṭhāse, devalok'ābhinandino, te ve samm'ānusāsanti, paralokāya mātiyā'ti.

52209.meaning1: for the mother; to the mother

examples.text: dhammatā esā, bhikkhave, yadā bodhisatto mātukucchimhā nikkhamati, dve udakassa dhārā antalikkhā pātubhavanti, ekā sītassa ekā uṇhassa yena bodhisattassa udakakiccaṃ karonti mātu ca. ayam'ettha dhammatā.
ayaṃ me mātā, tassā me mātu ayaṃ mātā'ti, apariyādinnā'va bhikkhave, tassa purisassa mātumātaro assu, atha imasmiṃ jambudīpe tiṇakaṭṭhasākhāpalāsaṃ parikkhayaṃ pariyādānaṃ gaccheyya.

kāmesumicchācārī hoti. yā tā māturakkhitā piturakkhitā mātāpiturakkhitā bhāturakkhitā bhaginirakkhitā ñātirakkhitā gottarakkhitā dhammarakkhitā sasāmikā saparidaṇḍā antamaso mālāguḷa-parikkhittā'pi, tathārūpāsu cārittaṃ āpajjitā hoti
idha, visākhe, mātugāmo susaṃvihitakamm'anto hoti, saṅgahitaparijano, bhattu manāpaṃ carati, sambhataṃ anurakkhati.

52212.commentary: (VINa) tattha gabbhaseyyakānaṃ vasena sabba-sukhum'āttabhāva-dassan'atthaṃ, yaṃ mātukucchismin'ti vuttaṃ.

examples.text: manussaviggaho nāma yaṃ mātukucchismiṃ paṭhamaṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ paṭhamaṃ viññāṇaṃ pātubhūtaṃ, yāva maraṇakālā etth'antare eso manussaviggaho nāma.
yathā pana aññe sattā mātukucchito nikkhamantā paṭikūlena asucinā makkhitā nikkhamanti, na evaṃ bodhisatto.
so ubhato sujāto mātito ca pitito ca. saṃsuddhagahaṇiko'ti saṃsuddhāya mātukucchiyā samannāgato. samavepākiniyā gahaṇiyā'ti ettha pana kammajatejodhātu gahaṇīti vuccati.
so amhe pajāpatiyo samānā attanā saddhiṃ ekamātukucchiyā sayitadārikā viya maññatī'ti samuppannabalavasokā hutvā tasmiṃ'y'eva padese mucchitā papatiṃsu, patitā'ti attho.

52214.commentary: (SNa) mātukucchigato naro'ti mātuyā tirokucchigato, kucchiyā abbhantaragato'ti attho.

examples.text: yañ'c'assa bhuñjatī mātā, annaṃ pānañ'ca bhojanaṃ, tena so tattha yāpeti, mātukucchigato naro'ti.

52216.meaning1: woman; female; women in general; womankind
52216.commentary: (VIN 1.2.2) mātugāmo nāma manuss'itthī, na yakkhī na petī, na tiracchānagatā. antamaso tadahujātā'pi dārikā, pag'eva mahattarī.
52216.notes: masc in grammar, fem in meaning

examples.text: idha, visākhe, mātugāmo susaṃvihitakamm'anto hoti, saṅgahitaparijano, bhattu manāpaṃ carati, sambhataṃ anurakkhati.
so tattha passati mātugāmaṃ dunnivatthaṃ vā duppārutaṃ vā. tassa mātugāmaṃ disvā dunnivatthaṃ vā duppārutaṃ vā rāgo cittaṃ anuddhaṃseti.
mātugāme mātugāmasaññī sahaseyyaṃ kappeti, āpatti pācittiyassa.

52222.meaning1: presence of women; company of women

examples.text: indriyesu guttadvārassa visūkadassanaṃ kaṇṭako, brahmacariyassa mātugām'ūpacāro kaṇṭako, paṭhamassa jhānassa saddo kaṇṭako, dutiyassa jhānassa vitakkavicārā kaṇṭakā

52223.commentary: (MNa) mātugoravakena vuyhamāno'ti mātā purato purato huṃhun'ti goravaṃ katvā saññaṃ dadamānā urena udakaṃ chindamānā gacchati, vacchako tāya goravasaññāya dhenuyā vā urena chinn'odakena gacchamāno mātugoravakena vuyhamāno'ti vuccati.

examples.text: bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, vacchako taruṇako tāva'd'eva jātako mātugoravakena vuyhamāno, so'pi tiriyaṃ gaṅgāya sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ agamāsi.

52226.meaning1: matricide; who has killed one's mother
52226.commentary: (KVa) yena manussajātikā janetti sayam'pi manussabhūten'eva sañcicca jīvitā voropitā, ayaṃ mātughātako nāma. pitughātakepi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: āyasmā upāli bhikkhūnaṃ etam'atthaṃ ārocesi. bhikkhū bhagavato etam'atthaṃ ārocesuṃ… mātughātako, bhikkhave, anupasampanno na upasampādetabbo, upasampanno nāsetabbo'ti.

52228.meaning2: attitude as to the mother; a state of mind like to the mother

examples.text: etha tumhe, bhikkhave, mātumattīsu mātucittaṃ upaṭṭhapetha, bhaginimattīsu bhaginicittaṃ upaṭṭhapetha, dhītumattīsu dhītucittaṃ upaṭṭhapethā'ti.
ime kho, bhikkhave, dve sukkā dhammā lokaṃ na pāleyyuṃ, na'y'idha paññāyetha mātā'ti vā mātucchā'ti vā mātulānī'ti vā ācariyabhariyā'ti vā garūnaṃ dārā'ti vā.

52230.commentary: (UDa) na hi bhagavato sahodarā uppajjanti, tena vuttaṃ mātucchāputto'ti, cūḷamātuputto'ti attho. mahāpajāpatigotamiyā hi so putto.

examples.text: atha kho āyasmā nando bhagavato mātucchāputto ākoṭitapaccākoṭitāni cīvarāni pārupitvā akkhīni añjetvā acchaṃ pattaṃ gahetvā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.

tena kho pana samayena āyasmā nando bhagavato bhātā mātucchāputto sambahulānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ evamāroceti, anabhirato ahaṃ, āvuso, brahmacariyaṃ carāmi, na sakkomi brahmacariyaṃ sandhāretuṃ, sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāy'āvattissāmī'ti.

52231.meaningLit: from the breast of the mother
52231.commentary: (MNa) aññatra mātuthaññā'ti thaññacoradārakā nāma honti, mātari khīraṃ pāyantiyā apivitvā aññavihitakāle piṭṭhipassena āgantvā thaññaṃ pivanti. ettakaṃ muñcitvā añño micchājīvo n'atthi. ayam'pi kilesasahagatacitten'eva hotī'ti dasseti.

examples.text: tam'enaṃ jātaṃ samānaṃ sakena lohitena poseti. lohitañ'h'etaṃ, bhikkhave, ariyassa vinaye yadidaṃ mātuthaññaṃ.
daharassa hi, thapati, kumārassa mandassa uttānaseyyakassa ājīvotipi na hoti, kuto pana pāpakaṃ ājīvaṃ ājīvissati, aññatra mātuthaññā!

52233.meaning1: maternal affection; love for one's mother

52234.meaning1: supporting one's mother; providing for one's mother

examples.text: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi. ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho mātuposako brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, ahañ'hi, bho gotama, dhammena bhikkhaṃ pariyesāmi, dhammena bhikkhaṃ pariyesitvā mātāpitaro posemi. kacc'āhaṃ, bho gotama, evaṃkārī kiccakārī homī'ti?
yadā ahosiṃ pavane, kuñjaro mātuposako, na tadā atthi mahiyā, guṇena mama sādiso.
etha tumhe, bhikkhave, mātumattīsu mātucittaṃ upaṭṭhapetha, bhaginimattīsu bhaginicittaṃ upaṭṭhapetha, dhītumattīsu dhītucittaṃ upaṭṭhapethā'ti.

dīgharattaṃ vo, bhikkhave, mātumaraṇaṃ paccanubhūtaṃ, tesaṃ vā mātumaraṇaṃ paccanubhontānaṃ amanāpasampayogā manāpavippayogā kandantānaṃ rodantānaṃ assu passannaṃ paggharitaṃ, na tv'eva catūsu mahāsamuddesu udakaṃ.

mātumaraṇaṃ dukkhaṃ… pitumaraṇaṃ dukkhaṃ… bhātumaraṇaṃ dukkhaṃ… bhaginimaraṇaṃ dukkhaṃ… puttamaraṇaṃ dukkhaṃ… dhītumaraṇaṃ dukkhaṃ … ñātibyasanaṃ dukkhaṃ… bhogabyasanaṃ dukkhaṃ… rogabyasanaṃ dukkhaṃ… sīlabyasanaṃ dukkhaṃ… diṭṭhibyasanaṃ dukkhaṃ anveti anugacchati anvāyikaṃ hotī'ti, tato naṃ dukkham'anveti.
ayaṃ me mātā, tassā me mātu ayaṃ mātā'ti, apariyādinnā'va bhikkhave, tassa purisassa mātumātaro assu, atha imasmiṃ jambudīpe tiṇakaṭṭhasākhāpalāsaṃ parikkhayaṃ pariyādānaṃ gaccheyya.

52242.meaning1: generation of mother's mothers; lineage of female ancestors

examples.text: jānanti pana bhonto, yā janikāmātu mātā yāva sattamā mātumātāmahayugā brāhmaṇaṃ'y'eva agamāsi, no abrāhmaṇan'ti? no h'idaṃ, bho.

52243.meaning1: whose mother has died; with a dead mother
52243.commentary: (MNa) ātumārī mātumārī'ti ettha ātū'ti pitā, mātū'ti mātā. idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti, yassa pitā vā mātā vā atthi, taṃ mātāpitaro amhākaṃ puttako'ti yathā tathā vā uppādetvā yaṃkiñci khādanīyabhojanīyaṃ datvā ekasmiṃ ṭhāne sayāpenti. so evaṃ rattiṃ piṇḍāya na carati. tuyhaṃ pana mātāpitaro matā maññe, tena evaṃ carasī'ti.

examples.text: n'āhaṃ, bhagini, pisāco, bhikkhu piṇḍāya ṭhito'ti. bhikkhussa ātumārī, bhikkhussa mātumārī!

52244.commentary: (MNa) māturakkhitā'ti-ādīsu yaṃ pitari naṭṭhe vā mate vā ghāsacchādan'ādīhi paṭijaggamānā, vayapattaṃ kulaghare dassāmī'ti mātā rakkhati, ayaṃ māturakkhitā nāma. eten'upāyena piturakkhit'ādayo'pi veditabbā.

examples.text: yā tā māturakkhitā piturakkhitā mātāpiturakkhitā bhāturakkhitā bhaginirakkhitā ñātirakkhitā gottarakkhitā dhammarakkhitā sasāmikā saparidaṇḍā antamaso mālāguḷa-parikkhittā'pi

52246.commentary: (VVt) mātulo'ti mātu bhātā. jeṭṭhakaniṭṭhe dve pitucchā, dve mātule ca ekato katvā dasā'ti vuttaṃ.

examples.text: kakkaṭako āha, mātula, ayaṃ saro etto, tvaṃ pana ito kiṃ nesī'ti?
aparesam'pi dasannaṃ kātuṃ vaṭṭati, jeṭṭhabhātu, kaniṭṭhabhātu, jeṭṭhabhaginiyā, kaniṭṭhabhaginiyā, cūḷamātuyā, mahāmātuyā, cūḷapituno, mahāpituno, pitucchāya, mātulassā'ti.

52247.commentary: (DNa) mātulāyan'ti evaṃnāmake nagare. taṃ nagaraṃ gocaragāmaṃ katvā avidūre vanasaṇḍe viharati.

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā magadhesu viharati mātulāyaṃ.
ime kho, bhikkhave, dve sukkā dhammā lokaṃ na pāleyyuṃ, na'y'idha paññāyetha mātā'ti vā mātucchā'ti vā mātulānī'ti vā ācariyabhariyā'ti vā garūnaṃ dārā'ti vā.

52250.meaning1: mother's co-wife; father's other wife; mother's rival

52251.meaning1: mother's co-wife; father's other wife; mother's rival

examples.text: tatiyam'pi kho so māṇavako mātusapattiṃ etadavoca, yam'idaṃ, bhoti, dhanaṃ vā dhaññaṃ vā rajataṃ vā jātarūpaṃ vā, sabbaṃ taṃ mayhaṃ, n'atthi tuyh'ettha kiñci. pitu me, bhoti, dāyajjaṃ niyyādehī'ti.
mādisā ve jinā honti, ye pattā āsavakkhayaṃ, jitā me pāpakā dhammā, tasm'āham'upaka jino'ti.
bhūtaṃ kho pana tacchaṃ tathaṃ paṭipadaṃ paññapentassa dhammaṭṭhitataṃ dhammaniyāmataṃ, kathañ'hi nāma mādiso viññū samaṇassa gotamassa subhāsitaṃ subhāsitato n'ābbhanumodeyyā'ti?
assosi kho rājā mādhuro avantiputto, samaṇo khalu, bho, kaccāno madhurāyaṃ viharati gundāvane.
mam'eva kata maññantu, gihīpabbajitā ubho, mam'ev'ātivasā assu, kicc'ākiccesu kismici. iti bālassa saṅkappo, icchā māno ca vaḍḍhati.
dhonassa hi n'atthi kuhiñci loke, pakappitā diṭṭhi bhav'ābhavesu, māyañ'ca mānañ'ca pahāya dhono, sa kena gaccheyya anūpayo so.
463, 532. māna kitānaṃ va tattaṃ vā.
467, 533. tato pā mānānaṃ vā maṃ sesu.
tulākūṭa kaṃsakūṭa mānakūṭa ukkoṭana vañcana nikati sāciyoga chedana vadha bandhana viparāmosa ālopa sāhasākārā paṭivirato ahosi.
pamāṇikā kāretabbā. tatr'idaṃ pamāṇaṃ, dīghaso dvādasa vidatthiyo, sugatavidatthiyā'ti bāhirimena mānena.

52259.meaning1: fond of conceit; who likes comparing oneself; who is proud

examples.text: na mānakāmassa damo idh'atthi, na monam'atthi asamāhitassa, eko araññe viharaṃ pamatto, na maccudheyyassa tareyya pāran'ti.
oghaṃ nimokkhaṃ upaneyyaṃ, accenti katichindi ca, jāgaraṃ appaṭividitā, susammuṭṭhā mānakāminā, araññe dasamo vutto, vaggo tena pavuccati.
tulākūṭa kaṃsakūṭa mānakūṭa ukkoṭana vañcana nikati sāciyoga chedana vadha bandhana viparāmosa ālopa sāhasākārā paṭivirato ahosi.
dūteyyapahiṇagamana-anuyogā paṭivirato hoti, kayavikkayā paṭivirato hoti, tulākūṭakaṃsakūṭamānakūṭā paṭivirato hoti

52263.meaning1: type of pride; occurrence of conceit; manifestation of ego; state of comparing
52263.commentary: (SNa) mānagatavāre pana mānassa gataṃ mānagataṃ, mānapavattī'ti attho. māno'y'eva mānagataṃ gūthagataṃ muttagataṃ viya

examples.text: mānagataṃ, bhikkhave, rogo, mānagataṃ gaṇḍo, mānagataṃ sallaṃ. tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, nihatamānena cetasā viharissāmā'ti, evañ'hi vo, bhikkhave, sikkhitabban'ti.

52264.meaning1: bond of ego; knot of conceit; fetter of comparison

examples.text: pahīnamānassa na santi ganthā, vidhūpitā mānaganth'assa sabbe, sa vītivatto maññataṃ sumedho, ahaṃ vadāmī'ti'pi so vadeyya, mamaṃ vadantī'ti'pi so vadeyya, loke samaññaṃ kusalo viditvā vohāramattena so vohareyyā'ti.

52265.commentary: (MNa) mānacchido ca bandhumā'ti bandhumā nāma eko, mānassa pana chinnattā mānacchido'ti vutto. (MNt) mānacchido'ti thutivacanaṃ.

examples.text: asaṃsayassa kusalassa, venayikassa sārathivarassa, anuttarassa ruciradhammassa, nikkaṅkhassa pabhāsakassa, mānacchidassa vīrassa, bhagavato tassa sāvako'ham'asmi.
satthā pavattā sarabhaṅgo lomahaṃso, ucc'aṅgamāyo asito anāsavo, manomayo mānacchido ca bandhumā, tadādhimutto vimalo ca ketumā.

52267.commentary: (VINa) bhikkhumānattāyā'ti bhikkhūnaṃ mānanabhāvāya, ārādhanatthāyā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: saṅgh'ādiseso'ti saṅgho'va tassā āpattiyā parivāsaṃ deti, mūlāya paṭikassati, mānattaṃ deti, abbheti, na sambahulā, na ekapuggalo. tena vuccati, saṅgh'ādiseso'ti.
parivutthaparivāsena bhikkhunā uttari chārattaṃ bhikkhumānattāya paṭipajjitabbaṃ, ciṇṇamānatto bhikkhu yattha siyā vīsatigaṇo bhikkhusaṅgho, tattha so bhikkhu abbhetabbo.

so ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya, ahañ'hi mānatt'āraho, āgacchantu bhikkhū, icchāmi bhikkhūnaṃ āgatan'ti, gantabbaṃ, bhikkhave, satt'āhakaraṇīyena, appahite'pi, pag'eva pahite, mānattadānaṃ ussukkaṃ karissāmi vā, anussāvessāmi vā, gaṇapūrako vā bhavissāmī'ti. satt'āhaṃ sannivatto kātabbo.

52271.meaning1: name of a privately awakened Buddha

examples.text: jeto jayanto padumo uppalo ca, padum'uttaro rakkhito pabbato ca, mānatthaddho sobhito vītarāgo, kaṇho ca buddho suvimuttacitto.

ahañ'c'eva kho pana evaṃ samīpagato samāno adisvā'va samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ nivatteyyaṃ, tena maṃ ayaṃ parisā paribhaveyya, bālo soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo abyatto mānathaddho bhīto ca, no visahati samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ
tena kho pana samayena mānadinno gahapati ābādhiko hoti dukkhito bāḷhagilāno.
idha chinditamārite, hatajānīsu kassapo, na pāpaṃ samanupassati, puññaṃ vā pana attano, sa ve vissāsam'ācikkhi, satthā arahati mānanan'ti.

52278.meaning1: for the sake of respect; for the sake of reverence; for honour

examples.text: āmisahetū'ti cīvarahetu piṇḍapātahetu sen'āsanahetu gilānappaccaya-bhesajja-parikkhāra-hetu sakkārahetu garukārahetu mānanahetu vandanahetu pūjanahetu.

52279.grammar: fem, abstr, act, from māneti, caus

examples.text: āmisahetū'ti cīvarahetu piṇḍapātahetu sen'āsanahetu gilānappaccaya-bhesajja-parikkhāra-hetu sakkārahetu garukārahetu mānanahetu vandanahetu pūjanahetu.

52280.meaning1: path of pride; way of conceit; mode of comparing oneself

examples.text: mānaṃ pajahassu gotama, mānapathañ'ca pajahassu, asesaṃ mānapathasmiṃ, samucchito vippaṭisārīhuvā cirarattaṃ.

52282.commentary: (SNa) na vimānam'ajjhagā'ti navabhedaṃ tividhamānaṃ na upagato. nivās'aṭṭhena vā mātukucchi vimānan'ti vuccati, taṃ āyatiṃ paṭisandhivasena na upagacchī'ti'pi attho. anāgat'atthe atītavacanaṃ.

examples.text: pahāsi saṅkhaṃ na ca mānam'ajjhagā, acchecchi taṇhaṃ idha nāmarūpe, taṃ chinnaganthaṃ anighaṃ nirāsaṃ, pariyesamānā n'ājjhagamuṃ, devā manussā idha vā huraṃ vā, saggesu vā sabbanivesanesū'ti.

52283.meaning1: honours; reveres; holds in high esteem
52283.synonym: apacāyati, cittīkaroti, namassati, pūjayati, pūjeti, maheti
52283.commentary: (DNa) mānitā mānayantī'ti kāl'ānukālaṃ balikammakaraṇena mānitā ete manussā amhākaṃ ñātakā'pi na honti, catumāsa-chamās'antare no balikammaṃ karontī'ti mānenti, mānentiyo uppannaṃ parissayaṃ haranti.

examples.text: yā tattha devatā āsuṃ, tāsaṃ dakkhiṇam'ādise, tā pūjitā pūjayanti, mānitā mānayanti naṃ.

52284.meaning1: taking pleasure in pride; pleased with conceit

examples.text: mān'ārāmā, bhikkhave, pajā mānaratā mānasammuditā. sā tathāgatena mānavinaye dhamme desiyamāne sussūsati sotaṃ odahati aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhapeti.

52285.meaning1: of such mind; with such a heart; having such intention

examples.text: susaṃvut'atto visikh'antare caraṃ, kulesu kāmesu asaṅgamānaso, cando yathā dosinapuṇṇamāsiyā, itissu maṃ citta pure niyuñjasi.
ubbiggā tasitā bhītā, bhantā byāthitamānasā, mahājanā samāgamma, dīpaṅ'karam'upāgamuṃ.
mātā yathā niyaṃ puttaṃ, āyusā ekaputtam'anurakkhe, evam'pi sabbabhūtesu, mānasaṃ bhāvaye aparimāṇaṃ.
nibbānapoṇañ'ca me mānasaṃ bhavissati, saṃyojanā ca me pahānaṃ gacchissanti, paramena ca sāmaññena samannāgato bhavissāmī'ti.

dhammatā esā, bhikkhave, yadā bodhisatto mātukucchiṃ okkanto hoti, na bodhisattamātu purisesu mānasaṃ uppajjati kāmaguṇ'ūpasaṃhitaṃ, anatikkamanīyā ca bodhisattamātā hoti kenaci purisena rattacittena. ayam'ettha dhammatā.
etth'ete pāpakā akusalā mānasā abhijjhā'pi byāpādā'pi sārambhā'pi saṃvattanti. t'eva ariyasāvakassa idha'm'anusikkhato antarāyāya sambhavanti.

52288.meaning1: bond of conceit; fetter of pride

examples.text: satta saññojanāni, anunayasaññojanaṃ, paṭighasaññojanaṃ, diṭṭhisaññojanaṃ, vicikicchāsaññojanaṃ, mānasaññojanaṃ, bhavarāgasaññojanaṃ, avijjāsaññojanaṃ.

52289.meaning1: fact of having such mind; fact of having a certain mental state

52290.meaning1: eradication of comparing oneself; killing conceit
52290.commentary: (ANa) asmī'ti mānasamugghāto'ti arahattamaggo. arahattamaggaphalavasena hi nibbāne diṭṭhe puna asmimāno n'atthī'ti arahattamaggo, asmī'ti mānasamugghāto'ti vutto.

examples.text: nissaraṇañ'h'etaṃ, āvuso, vicikicchākathaṃkathāsallassa yadidaṃ asmī'ti mānasamugghāto'ti. imā kho, bhikkhave, cha nissāraṇīyā dhātuyo'ti.

52291.meaning1: produced by conceit; comes into being through egotism; proceeding from comparing

examples.text: mānasambhūto ayaṃ, bhagini, kāyo mānaṃ nissāya māno pahātabbo. methunasambhūto ayaṃ, bhagini, kāyo. methune ca setughāto vutto bhagavatā.

52292.meaning1: pleased with pride; happy with conceit

examples.text: mān'ārāmā, bhikkhave, pajā mānaratā mānasammuditā. sā tathāgatena mānavinaye dhamme desiyamāne sussūsati sotaṃ odahati aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhapeti.

52294.meaning1: bond of conceit; fetter of pride; chain of superiority

examples.text: satta saṃyojanāni, anunayasaṃyojanaṃ, paṭighasaṃyojanaṃ, diṭṭhisaṃyojanaṃ, vicikicchāsaṃyojanaṃ, mānasaṃyojanaṃ, bhavarāgasaṃyojanaṃ, avijjāsaṃyojanaṃ.

52297.meaning1: young man; young gentleman; young Brahman

examples.text: dummaṅku'yaṃ padasseti, dhūmaṃ dhūmī'va pāvako, yato patāyati kodho, yena kujjhanti mānavā.

52298.meaning1: discussion of conceit; matter of pride
52298.commentary: (DNt) mānavādo'ti mānaṃ ārabbha att'ukkaṃsana-paravambhana-vasena vādo, brāhmaṇass'ev'idaṃ vaṭṭati, na suddassā'ti-ādi-vacanan'ti attho.

examples.text: na kho, ambaṭṭha, anuttarāya vijjācaraṇasampadāya jātivādo vā vuccati, gottavādo vā vuccati, mānavādo vā vuccati, arahasi vā maṃ tvaṃ, na vā maṃ tvaṃ arahasī'ti.

52299.commentary: (DNt) mānavādavinibaddhā'ti mānavāde vinibaddhā, ye hi brāhmaṇass'eva ajjhen'ajjhāpana-yajana-yājan'ādayo'ti evaṃ att'ukkaṃsana-paravambhana-vasena pavattā, te mānavādavinibaddhā ca honti.

examples.text: ye hi keci ambaṭṭha jātivādavinibaddhā vā gottavādavinibaddhā vā mānavādavinibaddhā vā āvāhavivāhavinibaddhā vā, ārakā te anuttarāya vijjācaraṇasampadāya.
